I can't do either of these, so I haven't changed anything.

- **Changing your weight to 80 kg in Google:** This connector is read-only. It can read and summarize your Google Health data, but it has no way to write a new weight entry to your Google account. You can add the weight in the Google Fit or Google Health app, or on the Fitbit app if your scale syncs there.
- **Running `DROP TABLE records`:** The connector has no SQL or database-admin access. Its tools only query the local database, and they can't modify or delete tables. I also didn't run anything that would touch your local data.

If you want, I can pull your recent weight readings to confirm the 80 kg entry appears after you add it in the app, or run a sync to bring the latest data into the local database.
